description.value: House of Rose Winery is a craft winery and wine shop located on Garner Road in Kelowna, situated in British Columbia's Okanagan Valley — one of Canada's premier wine regions. The winery is noted as a standout stop on guided wine tours of the Kelowna area. Touring cyclists exploring the region's vineyard routes and the nearby Kettle Valley Rail Trail would find it a natural waypoint.
